dataPolicy.data: published recorded ARC correctness, evaluation costs, and parent links
dataPolicy.generation: follow recorded children with hypothetical proposal charges
dataPolicy.holdout: scores are available only after search and separate admission

plan.nativeEmptyPolicy: Draw the native parent and all minibatches, then keep only tasks backed by supplied openings or children of that parent. Full-round keeps the published GEPA reserves. Available-slots reserves after sampling for uncached parent reads, a full child evaluation for each retained task, and remaining proposal quotes.
plan.parentEligibility: After supplied openings, give all policies the same remaining-child predicate. Tracked candidates remain eligible for final selection.
plan.skipEmptyPolicy: Keep the seeded parent draw. Charge no training read or proposal for an empty slot.
